title: Grand Almaty, Baku and Sheki
alt: Stained glass shebeke windows of the Palace of Sheki Khans
transport: Private transfers, private day tours and an internal flight

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Well run hotel in the centre with a garden courtyard

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

activities.name: Lake Issyk day tour
activities.match: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty
activities.description: A private day east to the turquoise water of Lake Issyk, with the Saka burial mounds and the small site museum nearby.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Four nights in the old Kazakh capital with the city tour, the Shymbulak gondola, the Green Bazaar and Lake Issyk.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Baku → Gobustan
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Friendly hotel close to the walled Old City

activities.name: Baku Old City tour
activities.description: The walled Icherisheher with the Maiden Tower, the Shirvanshahs' palace, Fountain Square and the boating canals on the boulevard.

activities.name: Gobustan rock art and the mud volcanoes
activities.match: Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour from Baku
activities.description: Petroglyphs carved into the Gobustan boulders thousands of years ago, then the cold grey mud volcanoes bubbling on the flats.

program.name: Baku
program.description: Two nights on the Caspian for the walled Old City, the Gobustan rock carvings and the mud volcanoes.

stops.name: Gabala
stops.subtitle: Gabala → Sheki
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel in the hills near the Seven Beauties waterfall

activities.name: Gabala and Tufandag mountain
activities.match: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain from Baku
activities.description: Nohur lake with its drowned trees, then the Tufandag cable car climbing above the town into the Greater Caucasus.

activities.name: Sheki city sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Palace of Sheki Khans with its shebeke stained glass set without glue or nails, and the stone caravanserai in the old lanes.

program.name: Gabala
program.description: Two nights in the Caucasus foothills with the Tufandag cable car and a day in the old silk town of Sheki.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Baku → Absheron
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Friendly hotel close to the walled Old City

activities.name: Absheron peninsula tour
activities.description: The Ateshgah fire temple, the Mardakan castle and Yanar Dagh, a hillside where escaping gas has burned for centuries.

program.name: Baku
program.description: Two final nights back on the coast after the Absheron fire temples and the Heydar Aliyev Centre.

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Sheki is the reason to take this one over the shorter Baku trips. That palace is the finest building in the Caucasus and almost nobody from India has seen it.
expert.tip: Buy the halva in Sheki rather than at Baku airport. It is made in the lanes behind the caravanserai and costs a third of the price.

summary: Eleven days from Almaty to the Caucasus: the Kazakh city and Shymbulak, Lake Issyk, then the Baku Old City with Gobustan and the mud volcanoes, the Tufandag cable car at Gabala, the stained glass palace at Sheki and the Absheron fire temples.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast across Almaty, Baku and Gabala; private airport transfers; Almaty city sightseeing tour; Medeu and Shymbulak day trip; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; private Lake Issyk day tour; private Baku Old City tour; Gobustan National Park and mud volcanoes tour; Gabala and Tufandag mountain day trip; private Sheki city sightseeing tour; Absheron peninsula tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Almaty to Baku internal flight; Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
